name: Pikka Sharp-Eye
source_profile: ● Pikka Sharp-Eye (NG) is a young scout pressed into the Mob after her home settlement was conquered by the Rattleknives. She secretly guides prisoners and unwilling recruits toward opportunities for escape. Having witnessed the succession of more than one Kreech Redcap, Pikka understands that killing the current boss will do little to end the Mob's predations.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 53 (source excerpt; may be partial)
